SAMPromptMetadata.description: Smarter API Prompt Manifest - Metadata class.

annotations.description:
The manifest annotations. Used for storing arbitrary metadata as
            key-value pairs. Example: [{'smarter.sh/test-manifest/project-name': 'Scooby dooby do'}]. The
            key should be a valid url-friendly string. The value accepts
            multi-line string values (YAML block scalars) and various scalar types including
            str, int, float, bool, datetime.date, datetime.datetime, decimal.Decimal, uuid.UUID, bytes, list, dict.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource
name.title: Name

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version
